name: Zacatecas

standard.note: Zacatecas's plate is pale and sunny, with a desert scene of the sun rising between mountains and a QR code that stores the plate's data.

plates.title: Current design (2022)
plates.fact: Zacatecas's plate is pale and sunny, with a desert scene of the sun rising between mountains and a QR code that stores the plate's data.

notes: The current design came with the 2022 canje under Gov. David Monreal (SEFIN started handing out plates in April-July 2022, zacatecas.gob.mx). On zacatecas.gob.mx and sefin.zacatecas.gob.mx I found only photos of people and promo graphics, no clean plate image. The 2026 'Ponte a mano' regularization programs suggest there is no newer design yet. I found no specialty plates.
